body.title: Wave Optics / Photonics Simulation: Tapered Micro-Waveguide Mode Coupling & Interface Loss Analysis
body.description:
We are seeking a photonics/optics modeling specialist to evaluate optical transmission loss and mode overlap across an adiabatic micro-tapered waveguide structure at telecom wavelengths. The model evaluates coupling between an integrated planar transition and an external single-mode optical interface.
Key Deliverables
* Modal Overlap & Waveguide Coupling Simulation:
* Model electromagnetic wave propagation at 1550 nm across an adiabatic tapered nano-cantilever/whisper-rib transition.
* Calculate S-parameters (insertion loss S21, return loss S11) and determine mode conversion fidelity into standard single-mode optical fiber (SMF-28 profile).
* Boundary Roughness Sensitivity Analysis:
* Execute parametric sweeps comparing optical transmission across varying sidewall roughness values (R_a ranging from 0.20 microns down to 0.02 microns) to quantify scattering attenuation.
* Dual-Frequency Transmission Check:
* Verify coupling efficiency and transmission profile across a dual-tone spectrum (1550 nm fundamental with ±5 GHz modulated sidebands).
Deliverables Format
* Formal simulation report detailing mode profiles, S-parameter curves, and throughput percentages.
* Simulation model files (.fsp, .mph, or equivalent native files).
